question: The chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction is a disease characterized by:

options.opa: Multiple stenoses and ulcerations of the small intestine.
options.opb: Secondary portal hypertension with intestinal venous stasis.
options.opc: Ineffective propulsion of the contents of the small intestine with pain and abdominal distension.
options.opd: Defective relaxation of the anal sphincter with difficult stool evacuation.
